body.purpose: All body text, form labels, table cells, list items.

title.purpose: Card titles, section headers, form group labels.

label.purpose: Badges, status indicators, sidebar section labels.

code.purpose: Code blocks, monospaced values, precision input fields.

shadows.name: surface-ring
shadows.purpose: Card borders, raised panels. Rings instead of drop shadows for subtle structure.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, sheets, modals. When UI interrupts the user.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default easing for UI state changes. Smooth deceleration.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Entrance animations, sidebar stagger. Sharper initial motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action. Near-black background, white text, 10px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; background: oklch(0.205 0 0); color: oklch(1 0 0); font-family: 'SF Pro Display', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.205 0 0 / 0.80); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.556 0 0 / 0.50); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent with hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-family: 'SF Pro Display', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.556 0 0 / 0.50); } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Bare minimum button. For icon-only actions and toolbar items.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg></button>

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Danger actions. Red tinted background, red text. Used for delete, remove, irreversible actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; background: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325 / 0.10); color: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325); font-family: 'SF Pro Display', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325 / 0.20); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325 / 0.20); }

narrative.overview:
Clean, organized, purposeful. Like a well-run auto shop — tools in their place, everything visible, nothing wasted. The interface should feel like stepping up to a counter where someone already knows what you need.

TOLOM's visual system is built on the zuiio design foundation and rendered through shadcn/ui (base-nova style). It inherits zuiio's precision and confidence but adds a layer of approachable warmth — the same quality, but in work clothes. SF Pro Display carries the typographic voice; a tight neutral palette keeps the surface quiet so the data speaks. Color is reserved for state (error, warning, success) and primary actions, not decoration.

This system explicitly rejects enterprise bloat (dense nested tables, dropdown overload), toy-like gamification, and generic SaaS templates. Every pixel on screen should answer "does this help someone run their shop."
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome-neutral core with red for danger, no decorative color
Single sans-serif family (SF Pro Display) for all UI text
Ring-1 borders on cards instead of drop shadows for subtle structure
Motion reserved for state changes (150–250ms, ease-out-quart)
Tablet-native: 44px touch targets, SF Pro optimized for Apple clarity

rules.name: The No-Decoration Rule
rules.body: The primary color is used on actions, selections, and state indicators only. It does not appear as background washes, section tints, decorative borders, or brand flourishes. If you're reaching for primary to make something "look nice," stop.

rules.name: The Tool Red Rule
rules.body: Red means danger or error. It is never used for emphasis, decoration, or "making things pop." One red alert on screen at a time is enough; two means a design failure.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: SF Pro Display carries every typographic role: headings, body, labels, buttons, data. No serif display font, no decorative weight, no secondary sans. The system's variety comes from weight, size, and spacing — not from font mixing.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, elevation, focus). If a surface isn't floating above something, it doesn't cast a shadow.

dos: Do use a single sans-serif family (SF Pro Display) for all UI text — headings, body, labels, buttons, data.
Do use ring-1 ring-foreground/10 for card borders instead of box-shadows. Never pair both as decoration.
Do keep card radius at 14px (--radius-xl) maximum. Cards are not rounded beyond recognition.
Do use gap-* with flex for spacing, never space-y-* or space-x-*.
Do preserve page chrome (tabs, headers, buttons) during data refetch — only skeleton-load content areas.
Do cap body text line length at 65–75ch in prose contexts (empty states, descriptions).
Do maintain 44px minimum touch targets on tablet layouts.
Do use text-wrap: balance on h1–h3 for even line lengths.
Do animate only transform and opacity — never layout properties (width, height, top, left).
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion — crossfade or instant transition for all animations.
donts: Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text). Solid color only; emphasis via weight or size.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left or border-right > 1px) as colored accents on cards, list items, or callouts.
Don't pair border: 1px solid X with box-shadow: 0 Npx Mpx ... (M ≥ 16px) on the same element. The "ghost-card" pattern. Pick one.
Don't apply border-radius: 32px+ on cards, sections, or inputs. Cards top out at 14px; full-pill is for tags and badges only.
Don't use raw color values like bg-blue-500. Always use semantic tokens (bg-primary, text-muted-foreground).
Don't use space-y-* or space-x-* — use gap-* with flex instead.
Don't build from scratch what shadcn/ui provides. Never write custom modals, selects, or tooltips when the library has them.
Don't use enterprise bloat patterns: dense nested tables, overwhelming data density, multi-level dropdowns.
Don't use toy-like gamification, cartoonish illustrations, or playful interface patterns. This is real business software.
Don't use display fonts or decorative type in UI labels, buttons, or data.
Don't use modal dialogs as the first choice. Exhaust inline editing, expandable sections, and drawer panels first.
Don't use bg-background or oklch(1 0 0) as API — use bg-card for surfaces that sit on the page background.
